PFPI

MANIACS WIN WEEK 7 CROWN AND LEAP TO 1ST PLACE, 
ENDING ROUGHRIDERS’ 5-WEEK REIGN ON TOP

Mom’s Maniacs scored Week 7’s only double-digit wins at 10-4 to move into the season lead, ending Dick’s Roughriders’ five-week reign on top. The Double-R are 1 game back.
 
There were a big three Unique Hits, with Greg’s Lobos cashing a Coonskin with Dolphins, the Llamas going solo on Buccaneers, and Gracelin’s Giraffes alone with Giants.

PFPI’s 23rd season is now seven weeks down and 11 to go in the marathon run for the Dad’s Dynamics Cup championship trophy.
